This is the 3rd episode of a 4 video series about Singapore. Just in case if you have missed the 2 videos published before this, do have a look at it for continuity.
We started the video from Orchard road, which is the shopping hub of Singapore. Following are the places we visited as part of this journey.
Date of Journey - 6th July
Mall Visit - ION Orchard & Sky
Hotel at the 55th Floor - But it was closed
Chinese garden - through MRT
Japanese garden - We saw a water lily
In the Japanese Garden, we went to the Sunken Garden
